bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears improved to 8-2 after a 21-13 win over the New Orleans Saints at Soldier Field, extending their winning streak as Jeffery Simmons had three sacks, Caleb Williams threw two touchdown passes and the Chicago Bears beat the New Orleans Saints 21-13 on Sunday for their fifth consecutive win. Despite the victory, the offense looked uneven coming out of the bye week, with the team now shifting focus to Thursday's Thanksgiving Day showdown against the Detroit Lions in Week 12.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions improved to 8-2 on the season after defeating the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 31-21 at Ford Field on Sunday , with Jahmyr Gibbs continuing his strong play by scoring his 15th touchdown of 2026 and Jared Goff turning in another multi-touchdown performance. The Lions also made a roster move this week, placing center Cade Mays on injured reserve for the second time while signing a cornerback and elevating a linebacker .

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The biggest Packers story today is that star edge rusher Micah Parsons has officially been cleared to return from the ACL and meniscus injury he suffered in December 2025, with Micah Parsons set to make his 2026 season debut Wednesday night against the Los Angeles Rams, according to NFL Network insider Ian Rapoport . This comes as the 6-4 Packers prepare for a Thanksgiving night matchup against the Rams, with Green Bay remaining in the NFC playoff picture while preparing for one of their most important games of the season .

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings suffered a lopsided 35-10 loss to the San Francisco 49ers in Mexico City, with Kirk Cousins unable to spark a comeback after Minnesota fell behind 28-10 at halftime and eventually turned to Carson Wentz for the final drive. In the aftermath, the team signed an offensive lineman to their practice squad, a move that could be related to a shoulder injury sustained by tackle Christian Darrisaw during the loss.
